दोलः [दल् घञ्]
1 Swinging,
rocking, oscillating.
--2 A swing, litter.
--3 A festival held on the fourteenth
or full-moon day of the month of
Phālguna when figures of ‘young
[]
Kṛṣṇa’ (बालकृष्ण) are swung in a
swing.

दोला, दोलिका
1 A litter, palanquin.
--2 A swing, hammock (fig. also);
आसीत्स दोलाचलचित्तवृत्तिः

.
--3 Swinging, fluctuation.
--4
Doubt, uncertainty.
--5 The Indigo
plant.
--Comp.
--अधिरूढ, --आरूढ a.
(lit.) mounted on a swing; (fig.)
uncertain, irresolute, disquieted.
--युद्धं uncertainty of success, a
fight with varying success;
Śi. 18. 80.

दोलिका, दोली
1 A cradle.
--2 A
swing.

To swing, rock
to and fro, oscillate, fluctuate,
vacillate (fig. also).
--2 To be restless or
uneasy.

दोलायमान a.
1 Swinging,
oscillating.
--2 Wavering, vacillating.
--3
Perplexed, doubtful.

दोलायित, दोलित a. Swung, shaken,
oscillating &c.
